description: This file is part of an online examination system, specifically handling a multiple-choice question exam page. It manages loading questions from a database, displaying them, handling user responses, timing the exam, and submitting results.

classes.name: OnlineExamSystem.MCQExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the MCQ Exam page, managing question loading, response evaluation, timing, and navigation within the exam interface.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles initial page load, fetches questions from the database based on course session, initializes timer.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to User Profile page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates the score based on user responses, stores results in database, navigates to result page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and navigates to login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates remaining time display; handles exam timeout when timer expires.
